subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & demo scheduling (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ian Thompson <ian@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & demo scheduling (CloudBridge)

Thanks for the time today, Ian, really appreciate the overview of CloudBridge's marketplace flow and the partners you see driving adoption. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Goal: Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive/demo focused on Redwood Dedicated + marketplace integration (SSO, billing, and billing metering hooks).
- Attendees we recommend: Ian + Lindsay from CloudBridge, Mateo (solutions engineer), Camila (partner integrations lead), and myself.
- Prep materials: I've attached our partner playbook excerpt that covers integration touchpoints.

Proposed time windows (all PT):
- Thu 5/27 9:00–10:00am
- Thu 5/27 2:00–3:00pm
- Fri 5/28 10:30–11:30am

Can you confirm which slot works best or propose a different time? If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks, looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0147

Attachment: RDW-Partner-Playbook-v1.pdf (summary pages included)

From: Ian Thompson <ian@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lindsay Park <lindsay.park@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: next steps & demo scheduling (CloudBridge)

Thanks Marissa, great conversation. Lindsay and I are available for the Thu 5/27 2:00–3:00pm PT window.

A couple quick notes:
- We want the demo to include the marketplace onboarding flow + the dedicated instance billing signals (how metering maps into our marketplace billing).
- Lindsay will invite a product manager who owns the CloudBridge billing pipeline; she may join as optional.

If that slot works for you and your team, go ahead and send the invite. Also can you include any short pre-demo checklist (API keys, sandbox access, sample schema), that helps our PM ramp quickly.

Cheers,
Ian
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge
ian@cloudbridge.com

Perfect, locking Thu 5/27 2:00–3:00pm PT. Invite attached (proposed-demo-times.ics).

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Redwood: provide a temporary integration sandbox, API key, and sample metering webhook schema.
- CloudBridge: confirm PM and billing engineer will attend; share any existing mapping docs you want us to review ahead of time.
- Goal: demo marketplace onboarding, Dedicated instance mapping to marketplace billing, and Q&A on SSO/KMS patterns.

Mateo and Camila, can you review and let me know if you want to cover any specific technical topics or bring additional folks?

Thanks, sending calendar invite now.

Best,
Marissa
